allowed_actions.description: Run the deployed app against independently specified public regression fixtures. Choose the next repair from actual failing outputs.
allowed_actions.label: Inspect an app

allowed_actions.description: Replace the actual executable expression. Independent golden fixtures review it; passing patches become current, rejected patches retain the working version and return to the queue. Language: x,y,z; numbers; +,-,*,/; parentheses; floor,ceil,round,abs (one argument), min,max (two). No JavaScript.
allowed_actions.label: Submit a source patch

description: A workshop repairs four executable calculator apps. A manager selects defects from observed outputs, a developer supplies expression patches, and independent regression fixtures admit or reject each repair. Run original and saved versions with your own inputs, and inspect their source, failures and measured progress.

facts: Four small calculator applications start with actual defective expression programs. Their inputs, intended behavior and test receipts are observable.
A repair supplies real executable expression source in a bounded arithmetic language, interpreted without eval or access to files, network or browser globals.
The independent runner compares candidate outputs with fixed expected outputs. Every fixture must pass before the current application changes; rejected patches remain queued.
Every attempt saves its source and measured outputs. Original and candidate versions remain runnable in the public viewer and immutable decision history.
Passing this finite regression suite supports these tested cases; it is not proof for every possible input. Working memory stays bounded while event archives preserve prior repairs.

last_decision.reason: Repair manager: all four apps are repaired and the queue is empty, so continue reviewer inspections. Developer: temperature currently uses x*9/5+32 and its five fixtures pass. Independent fixture reviewer: inspection remeasures those cases; it does not establish correctness for every input. Alternatives: inspect boxes, just inspected with five passes; patch an app despite no observed failing fixture motivating a change.
